This is a concrete, diff-grounded risk worth flagging, but not necessarily a guaranteed bug in normal operation.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17 — record_for_host` compares `lower(host)` against the un-downcased `uri.host`, and stored hosts may include a `:port` while `uri.host` never does, so mixed-case or port-bearing referers/hosts are inconsistently rejected; downcase and compare host:port consistently.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`, `record_for_host` does `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` after setting `host = uri.host`. `uri.host` is not downcased, so for mixed-case referers (e.g. `EvilTrout.com`) the query becomes `lower(host) = 'EvilTrout.com'` and will not match `lower(host)` in case-sensitive DB comparisons.
